[[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] '''Tagge''' was head of the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. She was due to inspect a [[Tagge Mining Company|House of Tagge Mining Company]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krann]].
